description: A mine tunnel with a partial cave-in: rubble fills roughly half the passage height and a support beam has snapped -- passable but tight, reads as danger. 20x7px.
notes: Rubble is real solid material woven into the passage (not decoration on top), so it actually narrows the path the way world.lua's own R.crumble() debris does; the snapped beam is two disconnected wood segments, not one -- reads as broken without needing the felling/physics system.
